Package zephyr.wallet.model

Class ZephyrWalletConfig

java.lang.Object
zephyr.wallet.model.ZephyrWalletConfig
public class ZephyrWalletConfig extends Object
Configuration to create a Zephyr wallet.

    • setPath

      public ZephyrWalletConfig setPath(String path)
      Sets the path of the wallet files: the cache is written at the path and the keys at the path plus ".keys". Without a path, createWallet makes a wallet that lives only in memory, for which save() writes nothing. See the user guide, docs/guide/02-wallets.md, section "Wallet bytes".
      Parameters:
      path - is the path
      Returns:
      this configuration for chaining

      Sets the password that encrypts the wallet's keys and cache; openWallet requires it. Treat it as a secret: do not log it.
      Parameters:

      this configuration for chaining

      public ZephyrWalletConfig setNetworkType(ZephyrNetworkType networkType)
      Sets the network type; createWallet and openWallet require it. Testnet and stagenet never reach the rules of the current assets. See the user guide, docs/guide/02-wallets.md, section "Network types".

      this configuration for chaining

      public ZephyrWalletConfig setServerUri(String serverUri)
      Sets the URI of the node (zephyrd) the wallet connects to, for example http://host:17767. Without it the wallet is offline. See the user guide, docs/guide/03-connecting-to-a-node.md, section "Setting the node".

    • getMnemonic

      Returns:

    • setMnemonic

      public ZephyrWalletConfig setMnemonic(String mnemonic)
      Sets the mnemonic (25 words) to restore a wallet from. createWallet refuses it together with keys, openWallet refuses it at all. Anyone with the mnemonic can spend every asset of the wallet. Treat it as a secret: do not log it.
      Parameters:
      mnemonic - is the mnemonic
      Returns:
      this configuration for chaining

    • getSeedOffset

      public String getSeedOffset()
      Returns the seed offset.
      Returns:
      the seed offset, null if not set

    • setSeedOffset

      public ZephyrWalletConfig setSeedOffset(String seedOffset)
      Sets the seed offset: a passphrase from which the core derives a different wallet from the same mnemonic. Only together with a mnemonic. Seed offsets are inherited from monero-java; not tested against Zephyr.
      Parameters:
      seedOffset - is the seed offset
      Returns:
      this configuration for chaining

      public ZephyrWalletConfig setPrimaryAddress(String primaryAddress)
      Sets the primary address to restore a wallet from keys: with the private view key alone it makes a view-only wallet, with the private spend key a wallet that can spend. See the user guide, docs/guide/02-wallets.md, section "View-only wallets".
      Parameters:

    • getRestoreHeight

      public Long getRestoreHeight()
      Returns the restore height.
      Returns:
      the height, null if not set

    • setRestoreHeight

      public ZephyrWalletConfig setRestoreHeight(Long restoreHeight)
      Sets the block height from which a restored wallet scans for its outputs; without it the restore height is 0 and the first sync scans the whole chain. createWallet refuses it for a new random wallet, whose restore height the core sets to the node's height when it is connected. See the user guide, docs/guide/02-wallets.md, section "Restoring from a mnemonic".
      Parameters:
      restoreHeight - is the height
      Returns:
      this configuration for chaining

    • getLanguage

      public String getLanguage()
      Returns the language of the mnemonic.
      Returns:
      the language, null if not set

    • setLanguage

      public ZephyrWalletConfig setLanguage(String language)
      Sets the language of the mnemonic of a new random wallet or a wallet from keys ("English" if not set). createWallet refuses it with a mnemonic, whose language it detects, and openWallet refuses it. Mnemonic languages are inherited from monero-java; not tested against Zephyr.
      Parameters:
      language - is the language, one of ZephyrWalletFull.getMnemonicLanguages()
      Returns:
      this configuration for chaining

    • getSaveCurrent

      public Boolean getSaveCurrent()
      Returns the save-current setting, see setSaveCurrent(Boolean).
      Returns:
      the setting, null if not set

    • setSaveCurrent

      public ZephyrWalletConfig setSaveCurrent(Boolean saveCurrent)
      Sets whether a wallet RPC server should save its current wallet before it opens or creates another. Inherited from monero-java, where only the wallet RPC client used it; zephyr-java has no such client. ZephyrWalletFull.createWallet refuses a configuration in which it is set at all, ZephyrWalletFull.openWallet one in which it is true.
      Parameters:
      saveCurrent - is true to save the current wallet
      Returns:
      this configuration for chaining
